payload.text: The triage queue for SAT-12 indicated an array output low warning (AL-1). Telemetry and hypothesis scoring identified array degradation (H1). Candidate recovery plan P-1, reducing payload duty cycle, passed simulation while P-2 failed. Plan P-1 was scheduled for uplink and successfully auto-executed under flight rule FR-2. The fleet status is now stable.

The fleet triage queue for SAT-07 shows a warning regarding load higher than commanded under alert AL-2. The diagnostic score identifies a stuck-on load under hypothesis H2. Recovery plan P-1 was proposed to switch off the payload, successfully verified with worst-margin SOC {S-3.worst_margin_soc}, and scheduled for uplink. The request for approval resulted in tier {AP-1.tier} awaiting Flight Director review.
